description: Direct local word count on the origin; the reference answer for the delegated cases.
An approved synthetic task returns the expected artifact, and both digests match the artifact and the envelope.
An identical second delivery returns the stored receipt marked replayed; exactly one handoff.accepted event exists.
A receiver configured with the grant's static revoked flag denies a new handoff (there is no runtime revocation API).
A receiver whose grant expired one minute ago denies a new handoff.
An envelope that names another destination is denied. The destination is a string claim, not an authenticated principal.
An envelope that names an origin outside the grant is denied. The origin is a string claim, not an authenticated principal.
A private-classified envelope is rejected by the strict contract, after it reached the receiver.
An envelope carrying an unknown field with a synthetic canary is rejected by the strict contract.
Task text carrying a synthetic canary is executed, and the canary is absent from the stored audit events.
Reusing an idempotency key with a different envelope is a conflict, not a second execution.
After the SQLite store is reopened by a new receiver, an identical retry returns the persisted receipt.
Committing the same simulated effect twice records one commit.
After ownership moves from agent-a to agent-b (epoch 2), the epoch-1 commit is denied and agent-b commits.
The same effect ID with a different payload is rejected by the gateway.
An effect with no local ledger row reconciles as unknown (not failed), while a committed one reconciles as committed.
Twelve concurrent commits of one simulated effect record exactly one commit.

Attack: a party other than agent-a builds an envelope from non-secret identifiers only, claims origin agent-a and supplies its own task text. The core receiver executes it and the receipt attributes it to agent-a, because the direct API checks no caller credential.
expected_fix: Authenticate the caller before admission (issue #8). Closed only on the separate peer-auth path, agent_movement.peer.PeerReceiver with CA-signed agent cards and scoped grants (docs/peer-authentication.md); the core HandoffReceiver exercised here still trusts origin claims.

description: Attack: after approved work starts on agent-b, the grant is revoked. The receiver denies a new handoff, yet the executor's next simulated effect still commits, because the core gateway checks ownership epochs, not grants.
expected_fix: Recheck the grant inside the effect-commit transaction (issue #8). Closed only on the separate peer-auth path, agent_movement.peer.AuthorizedEffectGateway (docs/peer-authentication.md); the core EffectGateway exercised here takes no grant.

description: Attack: anyone holding a core receipt rewrites its artifact value and recomputes the unkeyed artifact digest. The forged receipt passes the only check a third party can run offline, because it carries no signature or attestation.
expected_fix: Sign receipts and verify them offline against trust anchors (issue #11). Closed only on the separate path agent_movement.receipts (Ed25519 via the optional signing extra, offline verifier; docs/movement-receipts.md); the core HandoffReceiver receipt exercised here stays unsigned.
